promptSet.title: HF Viewer Overview & Architecture Features
promptSet.description:
HF Viewer – Turn Hugging Face Models into Interactive Architecture Graphs

HF Viewer (hfviewer.com) is an open web tool and browser extension developed by Embedl that instantly transforms any machine learning model on Hugging Face into an interactive, visual architecture graph. Instead of manually sifting through thousands of lines of PyTorch or Safetensors code, nested module classes, and config.json files, HF Viewer provides a clear structural blueprint right in your browser.

Whether you are analyzing open-weights LLMs (Llama 3, DeepSeek, Mistral), vision transformers (ViT, CLIP), or multi-modal diffusion pipelines, HF Viewer breaks down the internal connectivity—from token embeddings and attention heads to MoE router switches and projection layers.

Key Features:
• The Instant URL Swap Trick: Simply replace 'huggingface.co' with 'hfviewer.com' in any model URL to immediately generate its complete architectural graph.
• Multi-Level Granularity Slider: Smoothly zoom between high-level macro blocks (encoder/decoder towers) and granular micro layers (RMSNorm, SwiGLU, Rotary Embeddings).
• Tensor Dimensions & FLOPs Inspector: Click any layer or edge to inspect tensor shapes, parameter counts, channel dimensions, and compute requirements.
• Interactive Graph Exploration: Trace dataflow pathways, identify bottleneck residual connections, and explore Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dispatch logic.
• Presentation & Teaching Mode: Fullscreen presentation mode ('F') and interactive laser pointer ('L') designed for technical meetings, research reviews, and team walkthroughs.
• Official Chrome Extension: Embeds interactive architecture visualizations directly into Hugging Face model repository pages as you browse.
• Zero Setup & 100% Free: No account creation, API key, or command-line installation required.

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Visualize Any Model
1. Go to Hugging Face: Open https://huggingface.co/ in your browser and find any machine learning model page (for example: https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3-8B).
2. Click the Address Bar: Select the full URL in your browser's address bar.
3. Change the URL to HF Viewer: Replace 'huggingface.co' with 'hfviewer.com' (so https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3-8B becomes https://hfviewer.com/meta-llama/Llama-3-8B).
4. Press Enter: The interactive model architecture graph loads instantly with all layers, blocks, and connections mapped out.
5. Zoom & Filter with the Granularity Slider: Drag the slider at the bottom to switch between high-level macro blocks (attention blocks, MLP towers) and fine-grained micro layers.
6. Click to Inspect Tensors: Click on any layer or connection line to reveal detailed tensor dimensions, parameter counts, and computational FLOPs.
7. Present with Hotkeys: Press 'F' for Fullscreen mode and 'L' for the interactive presentation laser pointer.

Official Website: http://hfviewer.com/
Developer Team: https://embedl.com/
Chrome Web Store Extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hugging-face-viewer/pehlolgbcfdngflnjglkhbbgghoaljfp

Click on your browser's URL address bar to edit the link.

Press Enter on your keyboard to instantly generate and explore the interactive architecture graph in your browser.
